scenes.headline: What Qwen-Image-3.0 means by real
scenes.sub: Long prompts, nested interfaces and tiny legible text, from Qwen's own examples.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Matcha! Qwen-Image-3.0 has a one-word pitch: real. Here's what it's reaching for, and where it slips.

scenes.text: Aim the model at deployable output, not prettier pictures: long instructions it will honour, tiny text that stays legible, and real-world knowledge.

steps.label: projectile motion, Sylow theorems, parasitology
steps.say: The opening demo looks like one math slide. It's one cell of a three-by-three grid: projectile motion, the Sylow theorems, a parasitology explainer, and more.

steps.label: nine technical posters, drawn together
steps.say: Nine posters, each with its own text and formulas, in a single pass. Describing it takes about three point seven thousand tokens.

steps.label: the instruction ceiling
steps.say: The new version raises its instruction ceiling to four point five thousand. How much you can draw is gated by how long an instruction it will honour.
Rich also means deep. One instruction renders a VSCode window, holding a Qwen Chat window, holding a WeChat thread, holding a coffee poster.
Each layer keeps its own authentic chrome. It's logical nesting, not a collage.

scenes.label: text size Qwen claims stays genuinely legible, not a texture
scenes.note: legible small text: the hardest thing in image generation
scenes.say: Then fine detail: text down to ten pixels, which most generators blur into squiggles. Qwen claims it stays genuinely legible.

left.title: Qwen's own demos
left.say: Every example so far is Qwen's own curated demo.

right.title: Independent testers
items: A notch below the best closed models
right.say: Testers put it a notch below the best closed models, with Korean typos, broken charts and misplaced data points. Legible is not the same as accurate.

scenes.text: An image model is worth more as a layout and typography engine for documents than as an art toy.

recap: 4.5k-token prompts: nine posters in one pass
Nested interfaces and text legible at 10px
Closed, and accuracy still catching up
scenes.say: To recap: longer instructions, deeper layouts, smaller text, and accuracy still catching up.
